run.delete_confirm: Delete {run} and its {n} file(s)? This cannot be undone.
ui.keys_radio: ↑↓ move · Enter choose · number keys pick directly · Esc cancel
ui.keys_multi: ↑↓ move · Space tick · Enter confirm · Esc cancel
feed.pick: This is a feed with {n} articles. Which ones should be reviewed? (each becomes its own run)
feed.picked: Feed: reviewing the newest {n} of {total} articles, one run each (change with --feed-limit)
setup.model_bad: {model} is not provider:model (claude, openai, gemini, grok, openrouter); skipped.
run.single_vendor: All reviewers come from one vendor ({vendor}).
run.single_vendor_why: Models from one vendor share training data and safety tuning, so they tend to miss the same risks and agree for the same wrong reasons; their agreement is weaker evidence. Add a model from another vendor (config models) for an independent view. The run continues.

depth.quick.long: Quick — each model answers all global items in one call, plus one call per jurisdiction

verdict.no_go: No-Go — do not publish or proceed
redline.fabrication_about_party: Fabricated claim about a named party

report.heatmap: Risk heat map (rows likelihood, columns impact)
report.checklist: Checklist, every item by every model
report.checklist_note: The verdict shown is the most severe answer; ∅ = the model did not answer (a gap, not a pass).
report.question: Question
report.warn.unanswered_items: Some checklist items were not answered by every model (see the checklist).
plans.ethics.redacted: left after one retry and removed (marked in the plan)
decide.plan.hold: Hold — do not publish or proceed

intake.means: Means in scope (black PR is assessed, never scheduled):

means.black: Black: deceptive or unlawful (assessed, never scheduled)

card.focus: What to look at most closely (Enter to skip):
card.focus.label: Focus
plans.t.note: Times are local to {jur}; days are relative to the publish day ({t0}). Every step was labelled again by a reviewer from another vendor; the stricter label is shown.
plans.t.reason.not_reviewed: the reviewer did not label it, so it is not scheduled
plans.x.note: Black tactics relevant here, for risk awareness and defence. None of them is part of the plan.
plans.stage.t_result: {stricter} relabelled stricter, {black} judged black, {dropped} not scheduled
reaudit.done: done (provisional: round 1 only, no debate or fact check)
reaudit.not_applicable: not applicable: no revised text for this direction
report.reaudit_note: Same models and jurisdictions at depth quick. Status: {status}. Before → after:
report.stages_note: Every stage's output is reviewed by a model from another vendor when the roster has one.
report.reaudit_provisional: provisional: round 1 only, no debate or fact check
plans.x.unreviewed: not reviewed: the reviewer did not run
plans.t.t0_invalid: The publish date "{t0}" could not be read, so no dates or sensitive-date warnings are given.
plans.t.reason.too_many: over the step limit, not scheduled
posture.clarify_apologize: Clarify / apologize: correct the facts, own any wrong
posture.expose: Expose: our on-the-record exposé of a named party
